title: Komputer prawdę ci powie (PKF 16/87) / The computer will tell you the truth
license: WFDiF, all rights reserved (FINA Regulamin: "Wszelkie kopiowanie materiałów jest zabronione")
notes: Polska Kronika Filmowa 16/1987, Polish narration from the Infosystem computer fair in the Hala Ludowa, Wrocław: a hall of mainframes, a boy at a plotter, a computer that recites the tongue-twister 'chrząszcz brzmi w trzcinie' with a New York accent (window 3), symmetrical dot patterns on a CRT (window 4), and the long window's printers making portraits from a video camera, then copiers photocopying dollar bills.
